inputs.name: ProviderSwitchApplyService.constructor.store
inputs.description: Provides get and revision-checked put access to switch requests keyed by session ID; apply uses them to claim a pending request and record its outcome. The interface also exposes list, which this service does not call.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitchApplyService.constructor.control
inputs.description: Provides inspect and resume for the named session; apply changes settings only after an observation is idle, has zero clients, and is fresh. Fresh observations are younger than 30 seconds and no more than one second in the future.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitchApplyService.apply.sessionId
inputs.description: Explicit Codex session ID used for the pending-request lookup and session-control calls. It must match /^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_-]{0,127}$/; other values throw an Error.

outputs.name: ProviderSwitchApplyService.apply
outputs.description: Resolves with no value after skipping a non-pending or unready request, completing an application, or recording a failed application outcome; it may reject on input validation, uncaught store/control failures, or a failed status write. Applying requires fresh observations showing an idle session with zero clients and verifies provider, model, and effort after resume.

errors.name: SwitchVerificationError
errors.description: Invalid IDs throw SwitchVerificationError('A valid explicit Codex session ID is required.'); a post-resume selection mismatch creates SwitchVerificationError('Settings mismatch'), which is caught to trigger rollback. A failed revision-checked status write throws SwitchVerificationError('Switch ownership changed; settings require manual verification.'), and uncaught store/control failures can also reject apply.
